productionOnly.qual:
((bucket_id <> 'portal-evidence'::text) AND
CASE
    WHEN (CURRENT_USER = 'authenticated'::name) THEN private.auth_actor_active()
    ELSE true
END)

((bucket_id <> ALL (ARRAY['portal-evidence'::text, 'inventory-evidence'::text, 'delivery-proofs'::text])) AND
CASE
    WHEN (CURRENT_USER = 'authenticated'::name) THEN private.auth_actor_active()
    ELSE true
END)

((bucket_id = ANY (ARRAY['delivery-proofs'::text, 'inventory-evidence'::text])) AND private.can_read_internal_evidence_storage(bucket_id, name) AND
CASE
    WHEN (CURRENT_USER = 'authenticated'::name) THEN private.auth_actor_active()
    ELSE true
END)

productionOnly.with_check:
((bucket_id = 'portal-evidence'::text) AND private.can_write_portal_evidence_object(name) AND
CASE
    WHEN (CURRENT_USER = 'authenticated'::name) THEN private.auth_actor_active()
    ELSE true
END)
